card.name: Surnames inside citation author lists
card.fires_on: Author surnames, or the end of a surname, in reference lists and in-text citations. It fires most on the second or later author in a list, such as Briggs, Burgess or Chandler.

modes.label: Later author surname
modes.description: A full surname of a second or third author in a reference or citation.

modes.label: Partway through a surname
modes.description: The final piece of a surname that is split into parts.

card.plain: It lights up on the name of a co-author in a reference list or a citation in the text.
